title: RefToRuntimeWrapper
$comment: The root is an alias over a definition that compiles to the runtime evaluator. A named type does not inherit its underlying type's methods, so without delegation the root decodes as a struct with no exported field and refuses every document that is not an object. The branch admits a non-null value on purpose: null decodes into such a struct without complaint, so a case that is valid and *not* null is what tells the two apart.
